output.answer: Restaurant Brands International Inc. (RBI) is the parent of the four quick-service brands Tim Hortons, Burger King, Popeyes and Firehouse Subs, and its FY2025 Form 10-K (Exhibit 21.1, list as of December 31, 2025) names roughly 180 direct and indirect subsidiaries across Canada, the U.S. and more than 15 other jurisdictions. Its principal operating subsidiaries include Restaurant Brands International Limited Partnership and The TDL Group Corp. (Tim Hortons in Canada), Burger King Company LLC and Carrols Restaurant Group, LLC (the largest Burger King franchisee, acquired in May 2024), Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen, Inc. and Firehouse of America, LLC in the U.S., plus regional entities such as Bobipai (Shanghai) Catering Management Co., Ltd. (Popeyes China), Burger King do Brasil, BK AsiaPac Pte. Ltd., and Tim Hortons Restaurants International GmbH. One important recent change: Burger King China is no longer a consolidated subsidiary — on February 2, 2026 RBI completed a joint venture with CPE that gave CPE roughly 83% ownership, with RBI retaining only a ~17% minority stake and a board seat.
caveats: Exhibit 21.1 lists only consolidated subsidiaries as of December 31, 2025; RBI holds many franchised markets and joint ventures (e.g., Burger King China at ~17% since February 2, 2026, and unconsolidated master franchisees abroad) that do not appear on this list.

The exhibit contains roughly 180 entities, many of them numbered holding companies (e.g., '1011778 B.C. Unlimited Liability Company', 'KR1 Holdings ULC'); the answer highlights the principal operating subsidiaries rather than enumerating every entity.

The FY2025 10-K notes Burger King China results were moved to discontinued operations beginning Q1 2025 and the CPE joint venture closed February 2, 2026, so the post-close corporate structure differs from the December 31, 2025 exhibit.

Additionally, following the acquisitions of Carrols Restaurant Group Inc. (“Carrols”) and Popeyes China (“PLK China”) (“PLK China Acquisition”) on May 16, 2024 and June 28, 2024, respectively, we established a new operating and reportable segment, Restaurant Holdings (“RH”). This segment includes results from the Carrols Burger King restaurants and the PLK China restaurants from their acquisition dates and includes results from Firehouse Subs Brazil (“FHS Brazil”) beginning in 2025.

MIAMI, Feb. 2, 2026 /CNW/ - Restaurant Brands International Inc. (NYSE: QSR) (TSX: QSR) (TSX: QSP) ("RBI"), the parent company of the Burger King brand, and CPE today announced the completion of their previously announced joint venture, marking an important step forward in Burger King China's next phase of growth.

[![RBI Logo (CNW Group/Restaurant Brands International Inc.)](https://mma.prnewswire.com/media/2874252/Restaurant_Brands_International_Inc__RBI_and_CPE_Complete_Previo.jpg "RBI Logo (CNW Group/Restaurant Brands International Inc.)")](https://mma.prnewswire.com/media/2874252/Restaurant_Brands_International_Inc__RBI_and_CPE_Complete_Previo.html)

Upon closing of the transaction, CPE invested $350 million of new primary capital into the joint venture ("Burger King China" or the "Business"), and now owns approximately 83% of the Business, with RBI retaining a 17% minority interest and a seat on the Board of Directors. The partnership combines Burger King's globally iconic brand and products with CPE's deep local market expertise, creating a strong foundation to accelerate growth and enhance the guest experience across China.

output.question: What are Restaurant Brands International's subsidiaries?

key_facts.fact: RBI's FY2025 Form 10-K Exhibit 21.1, 'List of Subsidiaries,' as of December 31, 2025, names subsidiaries in Canada, Argentina, Brazil, Cayman Islands, China, Germany, Guernsey, Hong Kong SAR, Luxembourg, Mexico, Puerto Rico, Singapore, South Africa, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, Uruguay and the U.S.A.

Principal Canada subsidiaries include Restaurant Brands International Limited Partnership, The TDL Group Corp./Groupe TDL Corporation (Tim Hortons Canada), Tim Hortons Advertising and Promotion Fund (Canada) Inc., Burger King Canada Holdings Inc., Firehouse Subs of Canada Ltd. and PLK Enterprises of Canada, Inc.

Principal U.S. subsidiaries include Burger King Company LLC, Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen, Inc., Firehouse of America, LLC, Carrols Restaurant Group, LLC, Carrols LLC, Carrols Corporation, Orange Group, Inc., Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen Investment, LLC, Tim Hortons USA Inc., Tim Donut U.S. Limited, Inc., Restaurant Brands International US Services LLC and New Red Finance Inc.

International subsidiaries include Bobipai (Shanghai) Catering Management Co., Ltd. and related Bobipai entities and RBI (Shanghai) Information Consulting Co., Ltd. in China (Popeyes China); Burger King do Brasil Assessoria a Restaurantes Ltda. and FHB International S.A. in Brazil; BK AsiaPac, Pte. Ltd., PLK APAC Pte. Ltd., Firehouse Subs APAC Pte. Ltd. and Tim Hortons Asia Pacific Pte. Ltd. in Singapore; Burger King Europe GmbH, PLK Europe GmbH, Firehouse Subs Europe GmbH and Tim Hortons Restaurants International GmbH in Switzerland; Burger King South Africa Holdings (Pty) Ltd.; and BK (UK) Company Limited and Burger King (United Kingdom) Limited in the UK.

On February 2, 2026, RBI and CPE completed their joint venture for Burger King China: CPE invested $350 million and owns approximately 83% of the business, while RBI retains a ~17% minority interest and a board seat, so Burger King China is no longer a consolidated RBI subsidiary.
RBI owns and operates through four brands — Tim Hortons, Burger King, Popeyes and Firehouse Subs — with over 33,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories.

RBI reports six operating and reportable segments: franchisor segments TH (Tim Hortons), BK (Burger King), PLK (Popeyes) and FHS (Firehouse Subs) in the U.S. and Canada, INTL (all brands outside the U.S. and Canada), and Restaurant Holdings (RH), created after the May 16, 2024 Carrols and June 28, 2024 Popeyes China acquisitions, which also includes Firehouse Subs Brazil from 2025.
